# iLab

> iLab is a mobile device, computer and Dyson repair service in Riga, Latvia, with locations in T/C Domina Shopping and T/C Spice Home. The site provides information about repair services, device categories, prices, diagnostics, warranty, booking and contact options.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://ilab.lv/): Overview of iLab repair services, locations, warranty and contact options.
- [Cenas](https://ilab.lv/cenas): Full price list for iPhone, Samsung, computer, tablet, and Dyson repairs.
- [Biežāk uzdotie jautājumi](https://ilab.lv/buj): FAQ regarding repair diagnostics, wait times, pricing, and warranty rules.
- [Kontakti](https://ilab.lv/kontakti): Contact details, working hours, locations and booking options for iLab branches in Riga.
- [Par iLab](https://ilab.lv/par-mums): Information about iLab, repair approach, service quality and customer support.
- [Noteikumi](https://ilab.lv/noteikumi): Service terms and conditions regarding repairs, diagnostics, and item drop-off/collection.
- [Pieraksties remontam](https://ilab.lv/pieraksties-remontam): Online booking form to schedule a repair slot and confirm part availability.

## Repair categories

- [iPhone remonts](https://ilab.lv/iphone-remonts): iPhone repair services in Riga, including screen, battery, camera and charging issues.
- [Telefonu remonts](https://ilab.lv/telefonu-remonts): Phone repair services for iPhone, Samsung, Huawei, Xiaomi, OnePlus and other models.
- [Planšetdatoru remonts](https://ilab.lv/plansetdatoru-remonts): Tablet and iPad repair services in Riga.
- [Datoru remonts](https://ilab.lv/datoru-remonts): Computer, laptop, MacBook and iMac repair services.
- [Dyson remonts](https://ilab.lv/dyson-remonts): Dyson vacuum cleaner diagnostics and repair services.

## Specific iPhone Repairs

- [iPhone ekrāna maiņa](https://ilab.lv/iphone-remonts/ekrana-maina): Dedicated iPhone screen and display panel replacement.
- [iPhone baterijas maiņa](https://ilab.lv/iphone-remonts/baterijas-maina): Dedicated iPhone battery replacement, often completed in 30 minutes.
- [iPhone uzlādes ligzdas maiņa](https://ilab.lv/iphone-remonts/uzlades-ligzdas-maina): iPhone charging port cleaning or lightning/USB-C port replacement.
- [iPhone kameras remonts](https://ilab.lv/iphone-remonts/kameras-remonts): iPhone primary camera module or lens glass repair.
- [iPhone skaļruņa un mikrofona remonts](https://ilab.lv/iphone-remonts/skalruni-mikrofona-remonts): Audio hardware diagnostics, speaker mesh cleaning, and module swaps.
- [iPhone ūdens bojājumu remonts](https://ilab.lv/iphone-remonts/udens-bojajumu-remonts): Liquid contact diagnostics, corrosion removal, and data recovery options.

## General Phone Repairs (All Brands)

- [Telefona ekrāna maiņa](https://ilab.lv/telefonu-remonts/ekrana-maina): Universal phone screen replacement and diagnostics in Riga.
- [Telefona baterijas maiņa](https://ilab.lv/telefonu-remonts/baterijas-maina): Universal phone battery replacement with part availability check.
- [Uzlādes ligzdas maiņa](https://ilab.lv/telefonu-remonts/uzlades-ligzdas-maina): Charging port diagnostics, cleaning, and replacement for alternative phone brands.
- [Telefona kameras remonts](https://ilab.lv/telefonu-remonts/kameras-remonts): Universal phone camera repair for focus, image, and lens issues.
- [Skaļruņa un mikrofona remonts](https://ilab.lv/telefonu-remonts/skalruni-mikrofona-remonts): General audio hardware cleaning or component replacement.
- [Telefona ūdens bojājumu remonts](https://ilab.lv/telefonu-remonts/udens-bojajumu-remonts): Liquid exposure diagnostics, component cleaning, and data protection.

## Locations

- [iLab Domina Shopping](https://ilab.lv/kontakti): iLab branch at T/C Domina Shopping, Ieriķu iela 3, Riga.
- [iLab Spice Home](https://ilab.lv/kontakti): iLab branch at T/C Spice Home, Jaunmoku iela 13, Riga.

## Key service information

- Diagnostics are available before repair work starts.
- Price and part availability are confirmed before repair whenever possible.
- Common repairs are often completed on the same day (frequently within 30 minutes) depending on part stocks.
- iLab provides a warranty of up to 1 year for all completed repair services.
- Payment options include cash, card, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.
